components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Used for main calls to action like 'Download App'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0ea5e9; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 0.375rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0284c7; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.125rem 0.625rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 500; background-color: #e0f2fe; color: #075985; border: 1px solid #bae6fd; }

narrative.overview: A daytime control room that balances data density with a clean, light, accessible minimal UI. It leverages sharp grid layouts, flat surfaces, and monospaced statistical blocks to evoke precision and operational efficiency. The environment is distinctly administrative, relying on subtle 1px dividers rather than heavy shadows to structure information.
keyCharacteristics: Crisp grid structures and thin dividers
Monospaced typography for data and status indicators
Restrained color palette anchoring on stark white and cool grays, punctuated by an operational sky blue

rules.name: The Divider Grid Rule
rules.body: Structure is built via 1px border lines, not overlapping shadows.

rules.name: The Mono-Data Rule
rules.body: Any live statistic, coordinate, or system metric must be set in a monospaced font.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only to lift discrete interactive controls or distinct modal alerts above the operational plane.

dos: Do use `font-mono` for all live tracking metrics and statuses.
Do separate dense operational data blocks with 1px borders.
donts: Don't use heavy drop shadows on structural layout elements.
Don't use the primary blue for large backgrounds; keep its role as an accent and action color.
